features.rationale: Turn the body and projecting spigot, including the end taper and both tapered sides of the centered annular groove, as one axial profile.
features.justification: The origin is the small left end face. The .062 CENT. groove root is symmetric about the location .250 from the main shoulder, as shown by the centerline and opposed groove flanks. The constant 0.57735026918962576451 is tan(30 degrees), calculated from the printed 30° end taper (D008) and 30° TYP. groove flanks (D009); angles are measured to the axis. The end taper has the printed .094 axial extent. Use nominal 1.247 OD; retain the unilateral tolerance as manufacturing metadata.

features.rationale: Model the central blind tapped region from the large right end using a standard tap drill and cosmetic thread.
features.justification: A #21 drill, diameter .159 inch, is the standard tap drill for #10-32 UNF (nominal major diameter D012). D013 specifies the tapped length, not a separately dimensioned pilot-drilling depth. This feature represents the specified threaded region only; additional pilot depth is separately unresolved. The end view locates the hole on the part axis.
